features.description: listings with title, photo, price in DOLR and category

complaints.missing: Swaplist has no listings. It's a marketplace with nothing in it.
complaints.down: Swaplist won't load the listings at all.
complaints.wrong: Swaplist listings have no photos and the prices are off. Is the bike 5 DOLR or 500?
complaints.titles_shifted: The titles on Swaplist don't match anything. A photo of a kettle called "Road bike".
complaints.no_photos: Swaplist shows grey boxes where the photos should be. I'm not buying a grey box.
complaints.price_x100: Swaplist says the lamp is 500 DOLR. The seller wrote 5.
complaints.all_free: Swaplist has a 90 DOLR bike under "free stuff". Went to pick it up. It was not free.

bugs.when: Each listing shows the title of a different listing, so the titles don't match the photos or the descriptions.
fixed: Each listing shows its own title again.
The titles were off by one. They match the photos now.

bugs.when: Listing photos don't load: every listing shows an empty grey box instead of its photo.
fixed: The photos load again.
Photos were pointing at a folder that doesn't exist. Fixed.

bugs.when: Listing prices are 100 times too high: something asking 5 DOLR shows as 500 DOLR.
fixed: Prices were in hundredths. They show the asking price now.
Fixed the prices. A 5 DOLR lamp costs 5 DOLR again.

bugs.when: Every listing is shown in the category 'free stuff', whatever it is and whatever it costs.
fixed: Listings show their own category again, not 'free stuff'.
Fixed the categories. Not everything is free anymore.

nearMiss: I looked at the listings. They list things. What's wrong with them, exactly?
Couldn't find a problem in the listings. Say which part is off.

features.description: browse, search and filter by category

complaints.missing: No search on Swaplist. Scrolled for twenty minutes to find a lamp.
complaints.wrong: Searched Swaplist for "jacket". Nothing. There are jackets on there, I can see them.
complaints.search_exact: Searched Swaplist for "jacket". Nothing. There are jackets on there, I can see them.
complaints.filter_ignored: Clicked "bikes" on Swaplist. Got a sofa, a kettle and one bike.

bugs.when: Search only finds a listing when the whole title is typed exactly; searching one word like 'jacket' finds nothing.
fixed: Search matches words in the title now, not only the whole title.
Fixed search. 'jacket' finds the jackets.

bugs.when: Picking a category still shows every listing from all categories.
fixed: The category filter filters now.
Picking a category shows only that category again.

nearMiss: Search runs. I searched for things and got things. What does it get wrong?
Couldn't find a problem with search. Which part?

features.description: a contact-seller button that reaches the right seller

complaints.missing: There's no way to contact a seller on Swaplist.
complaints.deep: Messaged a seller on Swaplist. A completely different person answered.
complaints.wrong: The contact button on Swaplist goes to the wrong seller.
complaints.contact_dead: The contact button on Swaplist does nothing. Clicked it nine times.
complaints.wrong_seller: Messaged a seller on Swaplist. A completely different person answered.

bugs.when: The contact-seller button does nothing when clicked.
fixed: The contact button opens the message form again.
The button wasn't wired to anything. It is now.

bugs.when: Messages sent with the contact button go to a different seller than the one who posted the listing.
fixed: Messages go to the seller who posted the listing now.
It was sending to the wrong seller. Fixed.

nearMiss: I sent a test message. It sent. What goes wrong?
Couldn't find a problem with contacting sellers. Which part?

features.description: mark items as sold so they stop taking offers

complaints.missing: Nothing on Swaplist ever gets marked sold.
complaints.wrong: Crossed town for a chair on Swaplist. Sold two days ago. Still listed.
complaints.no_sold_badge: Crossed town for a chair on Swaplist. Sold two days ago. Still listed.
complaints.offers_open: Made an offer on Swaplist. It says sold right there. It took my offer anyway.

bugs.when: Sold items don't show as sold; they look available even when the seller wrote that it's sold.
fixed: Sold items show as sold again.
The sold badge is back.

bugs.when: Sold items still take offers: the Make an offer button stays on after an item is sold.
fixed: Sold items stop taking offers now.
The offer button goes away once something sells.

nearMiss: Things get marked sold. I watched one. What's the problem?
Couldn't find a problem with the sold status. Which part?

complaints.offline: Swaplist is down. I had three things listed on there.
complaints.stale: Swaplist hasn't changed in days. Is anyone running it?
